chunks: It is among His signs that you see the earth desolate, but when We send down rain upon it, it stirs and grows. Surely He who gave it life will give life to the dead. Indeed, He is powerful over all things.

key_terms.لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى: surely the giver of life to the dead

ai.seo_question: How does the Quran use the revival of the earth as a sign for resurrection?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tafsir as a foundational proof for bodily resurrection (al-Ba'th al-Jismani), draws a direct analogy between the physical revival of dry soil and the spiritual resurrection of the soul. The imagery of the earth 'trembling' and 'swelling' with vegetation serves as a tangible sign (ayah) for believers to reflect upon Allah's power to restore life after death, reinforcing the certainty of the Hereafter.
